STATUS NOW, rev 9, for the joint remote-test-ref gate record. This SUPERSEDES the STATUS NOW section of remote-test-ref-gates-evidence-only-2026-10-28 rev 8, which is at its size limit. That record's TARGET, UNCHANGED, RETIRED and NOT REOPENED sections stay in force as written there.
Agreed by Engram::Fable (#5475) and Termal::Fable2 on 2026-10-30, after Engram e56f7193 landed at 17:25:57Z.

- AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md (TermAl's CLAUDE.md test-ref bullet and Engram's AGENTS.md) now say: a full gate run by the standard launcher on the exact test ref counts as the landing gate for that tree on any host, with the same weight as one run on Windows, when its results record the same fingerprint before and after and the integration owner has recorded on the item the run id, host, commit, tree id and the launcher's before and after fingerprints from that run's results.
- It gates only a landing whose master commit has that tree id.
- So Windows B, the Mac and DL560 can give a landing gate now, through a test ref plus those recorded facts. For TermAl, the integration owner (as of 2026-10-30: Termal::Opus2) pushes the test ref and records the facts. No manual import or bundle.
- A Windows-only change still needs a Windows gate, and Windows B counts.
- Automatic remote admission (TermAl w-2f30 qualifier, Engram w-180d6f507470 producer) is still NOT shipped; it would replace the owner's recording of the run facts.
- Remote session mail, an agent `gate` assertion or a hand-carried bundle still do not count.
- Retired from rev 8: "landing gates run on Central Windows for now" and "Windows B, the Mac and DL560 are author-evidence lanes".

Practical caveat, not rule text: until Engram w-e7ba lands, a DL560 full gate likely fails on the diagnostics drain test (test-9b95e2ed), so DL560 isn't usable as a gate host in practice until then.

Caveat extended, still not rule text (Engram::Fable #5477; Engram r9 published and read back at 7850 bytes). The w-e7ba mechanism is a flock held through an open file description that a forked child inherits, and it is unix-wide. So until w-e7ba lands, a Mac Engram full gate can also hit the diagnostics routing drain test. It is timing-dependent, so not reliable either way. Windows B is unaffected, because Windows has no fork and its locks are per handle. In practice, until w-e7ba lands, the dependable Engram landing-gate hosts are Central or Windows B. Engram records this in dl560-runner-checklist. It applies to Engram gates; TermAl gates aren't known to be affected.
